validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Confirmed real and under construction. P6723 is one segment of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3 / MGS III), specifically Package 6 = 'laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-4 to EWPS-6, covering 370 km' (two parallel 56-in lines, EWGP-3 and EWGP-4). Independently documented by MEED (Package 6, Sinopec Petroleum Services selected), Blackridge Research project profile (Package 6, EWPS-4->EWPS-6, 370 km, 56-in, lines EWGP-3/EWGP-4), DMS Projects, and Pipeline Technology Journal (L&T completed a 120-km 56-in MGS section). Not a GEM-only entity. CLASSIFICATION: Correctly a gas transmission trunk line (Master Gas System east-west trunk carrying processed sales gas); Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission are correct. DUPLICATE: P6723 (line '3') and P6724 (line '4') are the two parallel lines of Package 6 (EWGP-3 + EWGP-4); they are genuinely two distinct physical pipes (370 km total / 2 lines = 185 km each), so they are correctly TWO rows, NOT a duplicate of each other. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/operator = Saudi Aramco, confirmed by MEED and Blackridge/DMS. SPEC: Diameter 56-in confirmed directly. Length 185 km is GEM's per-line split of the stated 370 km two-line Package 6 figure (370/2=185) -> internally consistent and reasonable, but note sources state 370 km for the pair, not 185 per line explicitly. CAVEAT: the per-line 185 km is inferred from the 370 km package total; if a route GeoJSON exists it should be checked. StartYear 2028 matches the project's Q4 2028 scheduled completion (construction began Q2 2024). Status=construction confirmed. Endpoints EWPS-4 (East-West Pipeline Station 4) -> EWPS-6 are confirmed by sources but currently blank in GEM (Location [ref] also missing) -> see fills.

fills.researcher_notes: Package 6 of MGS-3 is explicitly 'EWPS-4 to EWPS-6' per both MEED and Blackridge. These are East-West Pipeline Stations along Aramco's Master Gas System east-west trunk; the corridor runs through the Eastern Province (and the MGS extends west toward Yanbu). Province set to Eastern Province for the EWPS-4 to EWPS-6 leg; downgrade to leaving province blank if a route shows it crossing into Riyadh province. Endpoints corroborated by 2 independent sources.

summary: P6723 (MGS III, EWPS-4->EWPS-6 line 3) confirmed real, gas transmission, Aramco-owned, 56-in, 185 km (=370/2), under construction, 2028 completion; no existence/duplicate/classification concern; filled blank endpoints EWPS-4->EWPS-6 (Eastern Province).
